::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 4th 1882  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Hertfordshire County Record Office D/EP F587 p24
:::

Dear Sir

I am much obliged for this notice, but I have always wished to keep clear of the whole subject of scepticism for fear of opening the thought of it to younger readers.  Would not the [Literary Churchman](organizations/other_76.qmd) be the best home for this notice

yours truly
C M Yonge
